summary: Example textfsm template defining Value fields and Start-state regex rules to parse NX-OS show interface output.
questions: How do I write a textfsm template for show interface?

answer_card.title: textfsm template example
answer_card.answer_md:
Define `Value` fields then `Start` rules:
```text
Value Required INTERFACE (\S+)
Value LINK_STATUS (.+?)
Value ADMIN_STATE (.+?)
Value MTU (\d+)

Start
  ^\S+\s+is.+ -> Continue.Record
  ^${INTERFACE}\s+is\s+${LINK_STATUS}$$
  ^admin\s+state\s+is\s+${ADMIN_STATE},
  ^\s+MTU\s+${MTU}.*
```
Save as `templates/nxos_show_interface.textfsm`.
